description: This file contains static utility functions for testing TensorFlow Java operations, including methods for creating tensors, operations, and array manipulations, as well as an inner class for resource management.

classes.name: TestUtil.AutoCloseableList
classes.description: A custom ArrayList that implements AutoCloseable, used to manage resources such as tensors.

methods.name: constantOp
methods.description: Creates a constant operation in the given graph with a specified value.

methods.name: constant
methods.description: Creates a constant tensor within an execution environment.

methods.name: placeholder
methods.description: Creates a placeholder operation with specified data type.

methods.name: addN
methods.description: Adds multiple tensors together in the execution environment.

methods.name: matmul
methods.description: Performs matrix multiplication with optional transposition.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a tensor into multiple parts along a specified dimension.

methods.name: square
methods.description: Computes the square of a tensor.

methods.name: flattenedNumElements
methods.description: Counts total number of elements in an ND array.

methods.name: flatten
methods.description: Flattens an ND array into a 1D array.

methods.name: bool2byte
methods.description: Converts boolean array to byte array for tensor creation.

methods.name: byte2bool
methods.description: Converts byte array to boolean array for tensor reading.
